description: Search an organization's discounts and access codes, with quantity_sold. scope=event needs event_id; multi_events = cross-event discounts; user = all of the organization's. Eventbrite: GET /organizations/{organization_id}/discounts/.

code.description: Exact code or name match. Not together with code_filter.

code_filter.description: Approximate code or name match. Not together with code.

continuation.description: pagination.continuation from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

organization_id.description: Organization ID (from eventbrite_list_organizations). This is NOT the organizer id in an organizer profile URL.

name: eventbrite_list_discounts
title: List discounts
